reading: R1 predicted the valid-switch row would lose separation under domain clustering before the violation row did. Confirmed. Valid cost-saving switches occur ONLY in telecom (airline 0.000, retail 0.000, telecom 0.064), so the 50-unit interval [0.019, 0.118] becomes [0.000, 0.064] under a domain-clustered bootstrap and includes zero. The quality-violating reduction survives: it is present in all three domains (gated 0.036/0.037/0.018 against raw-log 0.300/0.200/0.040), so the -0.449 contrast is not a single-domain artifact.
